changes.title: Statue spacing
items: The challenge circle is bigger, and its statues stand further apart: each young statue stands nearer the middle than its adult, mostly in view instead of hidden behind it.
The sigils on the challenge circle's columns float clear above the columns' tops instead of sinking into them.

changes.title: Roster variety
items: A kind's island has more kinds of creature and fewer repeats: each other kind lives in one area while kinds from its own side of the compass last, and gets a second only after.

changes.title: Phase sizes
items: Islands grow by five areas a phase: 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 (they were 10 to 50), so later nights are shorter
Packs grow with the island's phase: a phase 5 island's last stump has full packs, a phase 1 island's a fifth of the way there
Home's packs grow as you find islands, reaching full packs once every island is found

changes.title: Legend sites
items: A legend's circle is always in its own legend area: two legend areas no longer share one area, so a circle no longer turns up in the wrong one.
Stumps, legend circles, the challenge circle and home now keep at least 50 m apart, and 10 m from any lake: stumps no longer crowd each other or stand in the water.
Areas are bigger (about 196 m across, not 168) to make room, so islands are about a sixth larger and the sea chart with them.
Where an area is too small for its legend's circle, the area now grows to hold it at its full size, rather than squeezing the circle up against a stump or the treehouse or shrinking it.
Creatures and legends heading across a lake no longer get stuck turning back and forth at its shore, and the beach witches always sit on sand with room for their campfire.

changes.title: Legend circle words
items: The legend circle's words are rewritten.

changes.title: Home start
items: Home starts smaller: 5 areas of home's animals, a different five each night, and one legend that leads to a new island
Home grows by an area for every island you find, up to all 64, with a legend for every 5 areas as on other islands, one of them always leading to a phase-1 island you haven't found while there is one
No find and no challenge circle at home until you've found every island; then home's challenge holds all 128 animals

changes.title: Guard chain
items: A creature parked at a sigil outside home now guards as far as its chain reaches (80 m), not 40 m.
A creature parked in the home area, or waiting there while you're in the treehouse, now roams the whole home area instead of standing by its sigil, and still defends it.

changes.title: Pattern strength
items: Soundsystems throw coloured spokes of light that turn with the beat. A slider on the pause page sets their strength.

changes.title: Veil readback
items: Smoke no longer dims hearts and rings, removing a graphics readback near fires.
